:::{#exr-vector-valued-practice}
#### Evaluating a vector-valued function at one input

A [vector-valued function](#def-vector-valued) returns several numbers for one input.
Let $g : \reals^2 \to \reals^3$ be

$$
g(\vx) = \sbmat{x_1 + x_2 \\ x_1 x_2 \\ x_1 - x_2}.
$$

Find $g\paren{\sbmat{2 \\ 3}}$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Substitute $x_1 = 2$ and $x_2 = 3$ into each entry,
as in @exm-real-vector-valued.

:::

:::
